title: Hadza Gut Bacteria Reach 730 Species
hook: Modern diets look advanced. Hadza guts carry about 730 bacterial species.
closing: Civilization made our food safer and our guts emptier.
question: How much fiber did you eat today?

segments.say: The Hadza of Tanzania carry about 730 gut bacteria species. The average American has fewer than half that.
The Hadza eat 150 grams of fiber daily. That fuel helps preserve far more gut species.
The CDC says a third of US antibiotic prescriptions aren't necessary, and each one can wipe out gut diversity.
